title: eleventh hour font
description: Replaces the default font with my "eleventh hour" pixel font.
body:
A simple resource pack that replaces the default Minecraft font with my eleventh hour font. It's a simple, mostly sans-serif pixel font that's tall, thin, and slightly janky-looking. It doesn't use any descenders, so some characters like x, g, and y are taller than the rest of the characters, and commas stand on the baseline.
It doesn't support every character in the default font, but it has a full set of uppercase and lowercase letters, as well as basic punctuation and most special characters on the keyboard (aside from the @ symbol).
The resource pack probably works with most versions of the game, but I don't feel like testing them all so I only marked it for the versions I tested with.
